inputs.text: A bracket that carries a hanging load from a pin to a flat mounting face bolted to a frame. It is loaded in four ways during handling, each for a short time. It is printed in PLA in a small series on the printers available. The mounting face must sit flat against the frame and the bolt holes must meet the frame's pattern. The bracket goes on a frame that moves, where every gram counts: as printed it may weigh no more than the mass requirement of the design says, with every other requirement as first given. Its shape is free within the envelope, the interfaces kept; print time is the objective once the requirements are met.
